description: SimpleBeacon local LLM model registry — maps model IDs to their Modelfile, context window, and optimized parameters.

unbreakable-oracle.description: SimpleBeacon's default code analysis model — based on llama3.2 with optimized system prompt for security and compliance analysis.

simplebeacon-llama32.description: Llama 3.2 with SimpleBeacon's code analysis system prompt. Smallest context window — best for resource-constrained machines.

simplebeacon-mistral.description: Mistral 7B with SimpleBeacon's code analysis system prompt. 32K context window allows more files per batch in multi-file sweeps.

simplebeacon-qwen-coder.description: Qwen 2.5 Coder — specifically tuned for code analysis. 32K context window with code-optimized tokenization.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Model ID to use for inference

OLLAMA_NUM_CTX.description: Override context window size (tokens). If set, takes precedence over Modelfile PARAMETER num_ctx.

PROCESSOR_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum file size (MB) for the automated processor

SIMPLEBEACON_OFFLINE.description: Force offline mode (local Ollama only, no cloud providers)
